summary_md: **Zenlyte ([@Z3nlyte](https://x.com/Z3nlyte/status/2116316681504989678))** highlights Microsoft's **Mage-VL-Cowork**, a 4B Apache-2.0 computer-use model that decides each turn whether to click the GUI or run terminal code. It scores 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified at 50 steps, and weights plus the training recipe are released ([microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork](https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork)).
